title: Accuracy of the AI-Based Smart Scope® Test as a Point-of-Care Screening and Triage Tool Compared to Colposcopy: A Pilot Study.
summary: In a prospective pilot of 130 women, Smart Scope® AI-assisted visual inspection with acetic acid (VIA) was compared with colposcopy at the same visit; positive findings triggered biopsy. Smart Scope AI accuracy was 76.53% against colposcopy (n=130). Histopathology was available for only 18 participants; against that reference, reported Smart Scope AI accuracy was 83.33%, sensitivity 83.33% and specificity 83.33%. The small histology subset leaves wide uncertainty and does not establish screening benefit in routine practice.
ai_technology: Cloud-based Smart Scope® AI analyzes digital cervical images for lesions during visual inspection with acetic acid.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: All 130 participants received colposcopy and Smart Scope AI-assisted VIA during the same visit. Against colposcopy, AI accuracy was 76.53%; among 18 with histopathology, reported AI accuracy, sensitivity and specificity were each 83.33%.
evidence.unknown: Only 18 participants had histopathology, so the gold-standard comparison is imprecise. This single pilot does not establish external reproducibility or improved screening outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: Cloud-based AI assessed digital cervical images during VIA and returned lesion screening results; the study compared them with colposcopy and, in a subset, histopathology.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
